title: 53--Supply Keys and Cores Parkwide - Lake Mead National Recreation Area (NV & AZ)
description: Lake MEad NRA is seekgin interested and capable vendors to supply patented key and core system (approx 1200 unique cores, 3000 cores total and 3600 keys total), compatible with existing BEST CORMAX+ system at Lake Mead NRA.  Patent must have minimum 15yrs left as of this notice.  please email bradley_metler@nps.gov with interest and capability statement.
